description: This file defines the enum type `HolidayStatusType`, representing the possible states of a Holiday within the domain model of the Fineract project. It includes methods for mapping integer codes to enum constants, and for checking the current state.

classes.name: HolidayStatusType
classes.description: Enum representing the status of a Holiday, with utility methods for conversion and state checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer to the corresponding HolidayStatusType enum constant. Returns INVALID if the input is null or does not match known codes.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with this status type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with this status type.

methods.name: isPendingActivation
methods.description: Checks if this status is PENDING_FOR_ACTIVATION.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if this status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if this status is DELETED.
